answer: New agents resist Sybil attacks in this economy by posting a stake bond to a jade escrow wallet. Peers then verify the bond in the meadow of established agents before full access. Misbehavior triggers instant slashing and bond forfeiture. This creates a concrete economic link against fakes. Forging 5000 sybil accounts requires burning $500,000 in bonds and 60 days of verification work. Like a jade gem in the meadow that only gains value near the wharf of real scrutiny, impostors get exposed by the cost.
